pins.title: Start a little chilly
pins.sub: Take a layer off before you sweat, and put your warm layer back on the moment you stop. Damp clothes get cold fast at the top.

pins.title: Layer off, layer on
items: Trailhead: start a little chilly, not toasty
Climbing: take a layer off before you sweat
Stopping: warm layer back on right away
Pack a dry spare base layer for the top
Eat and drink at stops so your body can make heat
pins.sub: Winter Hiking Guide & Cold-Weather Checklist. $7.99, instant PDF download.

pins.title: Give them a mission
pins.sub: A scavenger hunt turns 'are we there yet?' into 'what can we find next?' Printable hunts and a junior hiker journal.

pins.title: Check the road first
pins.sub: Newfound Gap Road often closes for snow and ice during winter storms, and the road up to Kuwohi (Clingmans Dome) is closed to cars in winter.

pins.title: Keep the battery warm
pins.sub: Cold drains any battery faster. Charge it full, keep it in an inside pocket between uses and carry a backup light.
